scripts.test: node --test tests/windows-registry.test.ts tests/windows-registry.integration.test.ts tests/toggle-setting-controller.test.ts tests/localization.test.ts tests/open-source-metadata.test.ts tests/manifest-security-logging.test.ts tests/release-api.test.ts tests/website-content.test.ts tests/dependabot-policy.test.ts tests/icon-legibility.test.ts
